name: Thorn Scimhilt
description: Holds the guard while the field extends like a hawk's gaze to every angle of approach.

name: Ruinous Cantle
description: Quarters the target with a diagonal cut chosen from the field's reading of the guard.

name: Rakeglimmer
description: Circles the foe at the field's edge with the blade always pointing inward.

name: Unbudging Saddleguard
description: Turns the edge through the line of a cut the field has already marked.

name: Rumblerake
description: Draws the blade through a seam in the armour that the field has found.

name: Blazerake
description: Follows a marked foe with a chain of slashes that never lose the field's trace.

name: Deepbelly Wrath
description: Throws a hair-thin arc of qi along the curve to a target the field has fixed.

name: Evergreen Flowedge
description: Holds a ward in the field wherever the foe's gaze or blade turns.

name: Broadcurve Flash
description: Flashes across the field in a single stoop and lands the cut as the foe turns to look.

name: Impervious Talwar
description: Readies the blade for the first of a pair of crescents with the guard held high and open.

name: Blaze Carve
description: Opens with a crescent cut from the left that draws the guard across the body.

name: Granite Whipcut
description: Closes with the right crescent into the gap the first cut has opened.

name: Dazzling Swellback
description: Walks the rim of an imagined basin so that every step keeps the foe at the center.

name: Murk Crescent
description: Turns the parry along the rim and sends the foe's cut spinning toward the ground.

name: Scoopscourge
description: Follows one crescent with a second on the same breath of qi so they land as one cut.

name: Ponderous Lop
description: Pinches the foe's blade between the two crescents and holds it motionless for a breath.

name: Silt Crescent
description: Slips through the gap between the foe's cut and the crescent returning to close it.

name: Rakescourge
description: Closes two crescents of the field like a pincer on all the foes within its reach.

name: Unbowed Swellback
description: Raises the field to the rim of the basin and holds it as one standing curve of qi.

name: Deed Arcwheel
description: Closes the two crescents on a single point so the cut ignores the guard's armour and lands inward.

name: Unassailable Scimhilt
description: Stands at the bend of the line with the blade held low and the weight even.

name: Ironscoop
description: Slashes along the outer bank of the foe's guard to undercut its footing.

name: Might Rake
description: Meanders around the guard in a curving path that denies a straight line to the foe.

name: Murktalwar
description: Carries the parry round the bend so the foe's cut ends behind the shoulder.

name: Unrelenting Flaretip
description: Pools qi in the blade's hollow and holds the guard like still water against a push.

name: Sanguine Flaretip
description: Cuts against the foe's flow just as it begins to turn and strips its momentum.

name: Synchronized Cantle
description: Links four sweeping cuts in the quick rhythm of rapids with no stop between them.

name: Hollowlip
description: Bends the point around the guard and punches it into the unprotected flank.

name: Overbearing Lop
description: Pushes the field outward like floodwater and holds the foe's weapon down against it.

name: Sweeping Arcwheel
description: Flashes round the foe's guard in a curving path and cuts from behind it.

name: Saddleguard Premonition
description: Stands beneath the open sky and reads the foe's weight by the shifting of the field.

name: Talwarscourge
description: Opens with two sweeping strokes in opposite directions to unsettle the foe's guard.

name: Granite Scoop
description: Retreats along one line while the blade threatens along the other.

name: Cantlespine
description: Grips with both hands and presses the flat across the body to take a heavy blow.

name: Gust Deepbelly
description: Folds the parry inward with the spine leading and ends it with a returning cut.

name: Might Scoop
description: Chains matched sweeps with a field of qi that keeps both lines of the cut alive.

name: Hoarfrost Flowedge
description: Pulls the foe's wrist through the hook while the second sweep closes on the ribs.

name: Granite Broadcurve
description: Sweeps low beneath a high cut and strikes the knee before the stroke lands.

name: Wrathful Carve
description: Cuts a broad pair of arcs through the nearest foes with the field behind each.

name: Decimating Whipcut
description: Wheels the blade in a full circle with qi trailing so every foe in reach is cut.

name: Granite Scimhilt
description: Weaves two linked fields into a standing guard that answers each strike with a returning cut.

name: Punishing Deepbelly
description: Drives both sweeps to the same blind point and punches the second through the first.

name: Shade Talwar
description: Folds the whole field down over the foe in one slow sweep and pins their weapon arm.

name: Unbowed Saddleguard
description: Sinks into a crouch with the blade trailing behind to ready the long low pass.

name: Mightcarve
description: Skims the edge across the foe at knee height without a break in the stride.

name: Silt Whipcut
description: Lengthens the stride into a run that gathers speed for the pass.

name: Might Talwar
description: Rides a rising lift of qi to hop clear of a low cut.

name: Murk Broadcurve
description: Checks a high cut with the tip of the blade and glides past on the outside.

name: Tempered Rake
description: Draws the blade along the foe in the long low pass with qi sustained the whole way.

name: Fastening Cantle
description: Snatches the foe's weapon from the hand with the hook as the pass goes by.

name: Blazelop
description: Turns hard at the end of the pass and cuts the foe's back as they pivot.

name: Thorntalwar
description: Lowers the field over the blade and body during the pass so no counter can reach them.

name: Granite Rake
description: Cuts along the whole line of the pass with the field cutting a swath wider than the steel.

name: Scoop Reckoning
description: Throws a hail of field-borne cuts past the foe's eyes to keep them from reading the pass.

name: Blinding Flaretip
description: Flashes the entire length of the pass in an instant and cuts the foe from knee to hip.

name: Charter Swellback
description: Stands in the middle of open ground with both tracks of the blade ready.

name: Eviscerating Flowedge
description: Slashes down the first track into the foe's shoulder in a flat arc.

name: Blaze Arcwheel
description: Returns on the second track so the blade cuts the same foe from the opposite hip.

name: Unbowed Talwar
description: Parries in the narrow space between the two tracks so neither is left open.

name: Lipscourge
description: Draws the blade across both tracks in a long X that opens the guard.

name: Saddleguard Reckoning
description: Switches tracks in mid-cut so the stroke arrives from the line the foe did not guard.

name: Lipruin
description: Cuts both tracks through the same breath of qi and the second drives through the first.

name: Flowedge Fortitude
description: Spreads the field wide as a ward that turns all blows from both tracks.

name: Unbudging Facet Broadcurve
description: Folds the field along both tracks so a strike is thrown back along the line it came by.

name: Facet Flaretip
description: Stands with the whole meridian network open and the blade held across the body.

name: Rakehavoc
description: Opens with the first of the twin curves cut from the shoulder to the opposite hip.

name: Scoopvortex
description: Pivots with the whole weight over the lead foot to open the line for the second curve.

name: Tempered Lop
description: Closes with the second curve that meets the first at the point of the foe's guard.

name: Inexorable Deepbelly
description: Feeds qi from the whole network into a parry that turns away the heaviest cut.

name: Beneficent Crescent
description: Reads the curve of the foe's guard through the blade and finds the weakest point.

name: Ferocious Crescent
description: Locks both curves into one cut so that the foe's guard cannot answer either.

name: Booming Carve
description: Presses the edge through a guard with the full pressure of the meridian network behind it.

name: Adamantine Swellback
description: Raises both curves as a standing ward and holds them against a long assault.

name: Rakewrath
description: Joins the twin curves at one point so the cut passes the guard and strikes inward.

name: Unconquered Cantle
description: Faces the wind with the sworn curve held across the body and the field leaning into it.

name: Blistering Whipcut
description: Cuts the forehand on the line sworn before the bout and holds it to the finish.

name: Silt Arcwheel
description: Leans into the wind with each step and lets it steady the blade's tip.

name: Gust Lop
description: Times the backhand to a gust that carries the curve past a late guard.

name: Impervious Flowedge
description: Locks the parry to the bearing so the foe's blade slides along it and away.

name: Iron Scimhilt
description: Draws the edge down a line sworn to the wind with qi unbroken to the end.

name: Carve Fortitude
description: Hooks the foe's blade in a squall of qi and pins it against the ground.

name: Daybreak Arcwheel
description: Sends a sweeping arc outward on the wind that cuts whoever stands in its reach.

name: Hoarfrost Flaretip
description: Holds the sworn ward against a hard gale of blows that finds no opening.

name: Corroding Scimhilt Reckoning
description: Cuts a single sworn curve that no guard or wind can bend and strikes inward through armour.

name: Hoarfrost Broadcurve
description: Stands at the brink of the stance with the heels light and the guard wide.

name: Carvewrath
description: Drops an overhand cut from the brink with the full weight of the body behind it.

name: Gust Saddleguard
description: Drops back one step off the brink so the foe's cut passes over empty air.

name: Talwarhavoc
description: Rises with a hook from beneath the guard like an updraft along a ledge.

name: Unrelenting Crescent
description: Rolls the parry along the ledge of the blade and drops the foe's cut off the edge.

name: Facetlip
description: Spreads the field flat across open ground so that nothing may approach unseen.

name: Devastating Rake
description: Draws the edge along the foe's guard arm while walking the line of the brink.

name: Booming Whipcut
description: Cuts across the crosswind with qi braced against its push so the line holds.

name: Gyvecantle
description: Hooks the foe's lead leg and drags it off the ledge of its stance.

name: Downpour Swellback
description: Cuts an arc as wide as the field itself and threatens every foe standing on the flat.

name: Aegislip
description: Holds the brink of the stance against a crowd of attackers using field and curve together.

name: Nova Deepbelly
description: Drops past the brink in a flash and cuts upward from below the foe's guard.

name: Facettalwar
description: Holds the blade at the hip with the point angled windward ready to draw.

name: Vengeful Rake
description: Draws the blade slowly at first and then faster through the foe's guard arm.

name: Ghosting Talwar
description: Steps along the held bearing so the foe's movement is always read in advance.

name: Rumblelop
description: Draws the long cut with a steady feed of qi that lengthens the stroke across the field.

name: Swellback Mettle
description: Draws the blade back from a parry to the hip and sets the counter-draw at once.

name: Brawny Cantle
description: Draws beneath the raised guard and tears the cut upward through the joint of the armour.

name: Nova Lop
description: Draws a blade of qi along the bearing through the squall to a foe at the field's edge.

name: Talwar Durance
description: Tethers the guard to the held bearing so that no strike may cross it.

name: Phantom Nova Rake
description: Flashes the length of the bearing in the span of the draw and lands the cut.

name: Inexorable Crescent
description: Readies the hooked point forward with the gale at the back and the guard low.

name: Blaze Flowedge
description: Cuts the forehand so that the hooked point rakes behind the foe's guard.

name: Blinding Scimhilt
description: Lets the gale shove the body aside as a cut passes by.

name: Obdurate Cantle
description: Drops the hooked point and rakes a low cut away from the legs.

name: Mayhemscoop
description: Drags the hook through the foe's footing and pulls the stance out of true.

name: Hoarfrost Deepbelly
description: Locks the hook over the foe's weapon and drives gale-fed qi down the blade to hold it.

name: Rumble Saddleguard
description: Whips the hooked point round the guard in a wind-driven arc and strikes the neck line.

name: Gust Broadcurve
description: Hooks a thrusting blade and sweeps it into the ground beside the foot.

name: Intentrake
description: Tears the foe's weapon from the grip and seals the hand with a lock of qi on the wrist.

name: Talwarmettle
description: Spins the hook in a ring of wind that catches and deflects incoming blades.

name: Overpowering Scoop
description: Pulls the surrounding wind into the hook and presses the foe's whole stance flat for a breath.

name: Lipspine
description: Stands in the open with no cover and holds the blade across the body.

name: Rumblelip
description: Swears the first cut of the bout and delivers it to the foe's shoulder without a feint.

name: Dazzling Flaretip
description: Circles the whole open ground in wide steps and never gives the foe a flank.

name: Chime Flowedge
description: Beats the foe's cut away on a breath of wind drawn along the flat.

name: Decimating Scoop
description: Holds the backhand to its line in the teeth of the foe's counter.

name: Whipcut Reckoning
description: Draws the oath cut across the open with qi that never wavers along the line.

name: Cantledurance
description: Turns the guard without cover and lets the foe's force run out beside it.

name: Lipnerve
description: Hooks a foe who turns to flee and hauls them back onto the curve.

name: Chimelop
description: Presses the foe's blade to the earth with the spine and keeps the sworn line open.

name: Daybreak Lop
description: Cuts one wide sworn arc across the open that no foe can step around.

name: Aegis Swellback
description: Holds the wind at the back as a standing shield through a long clash.

name: Hollowrake
description: Cuts through a locked guard with a single sworn stroke and does not slow.

name: Grave Scoop
description: Cuts the sworn line with sovereign force and strikes through any guard to the body behind it.

name: Unassailable Flaretip
description: Faces the distance with the blade tilted and the field open toward the far edge.

name: Punishing Saddleguard
description: Cuts an overcut with the eyes on the far bearing rather than the near blade.

name: Ghosting Arcwheel
description: Strides straight along the bearing and does not turn from it.

name: Waning Scimhilt
description: Reads the foe at the field's farthest limit through the faint pull on the blade.

name: Carvescourge
description: Holds a cut on a far bearing and extends it with qi until it reaches the foe.

name: Impervious Broadcurve
description: Parries along the bearing so the foe's cut is turned before it arrives.

name: Fastening Talwar
description: Hooks the foe's arm from beyond the guard's reach with the field extending the point.

name: Facet Whipcut
description: Casts a line of qi along the bearing that cuts the target at the limit of the field.

name: Cantle Mettle
description: Holds the bearing steady against a storm of blows and keeps the body behind it.

name: Rumble Deepbelly
description: Flashes along the far bearing so the cut lands before the foe has seen the draw.

name: Thorn Saddleguard
description: Guards windward with the complete meridian network open and qi pressed to the blade.

name: Talwarruin
description: Cuts the first curve with the full network driving qi through the shoulder.

name: Torrent Rake
description: Lets the wind lift each footfall so the body moves lightly around the foe.

name: Obdurate Flowedge
description: Turns a parry on the gale's edge so the foe's blade is thrown wide of the line.

name: Grievous Crescent
description: Draws the curve with the wind at its back so the cut deepens along its length.

name: Crescent Mettle
description: Binds the foe's blade with a gust of qi and holds it against the curve.

name: Glinttalwar
description: Carries the gale through the full network and punches one cut through the foe's guard.

name: Iron Deepbelly
description: Spins the blade in a standing ring of wind that holds against several foes.

name: Impervious Glamour Scimhilt
description: Folds the gale into the blade's curve and throws a heavy strike back along its line.
